primary.title: How SQM Turned a 678 km² Mine into an Autonomous Inspection Zone
primary.why_strongest_fit: This is FlytBase's own case study about SQM, the lead's company. It covers an autonomous inspection deployment in the Atacama Desert in northern Chile, so the industry, country, terrain and climate all match. It shows dock-based drones replacing manual field inspections across a 678 km² operation, which is close to Rodrigo Castillo's goal of replacing expensive, hazardous contracted crews at 3 large 24/7 sites. Because the work was done with Chile-based integrator Adentu and connected to SQM's Azure environment, the integration and local-delivery questions already have answers inside SQM. One caveat: the case study describes iodine/nitrate irrigation inspection under SQM's innovation team, not the lithium brine sites. The pitch is therefore an internal expansion from a proven SQM pilot to the Northern Operations lithium sites, not a cold reference.
key_proof_points: SQM "cut inspection time from days to hours" (S1)
"improved iodine extraction yield by two percent" (S1). The page headline instead says "4× iodine yield improvement", so check which figure FlytBase uses before quoting either one.
Deployment covers SQM's "678 km² mining operation in northern Chile" in the Atacama Desert, started as "one DJI Dock, one zone, one use case" (S1)
"The FlytBase platform let us automate daily missions, health checks, and data transfers, building a truly hands-free workflow" - José Pablo Mujica, Adentu (S1)
primary.how_to_use_it: Open with it. Something like: 'SQM's digital innovation team already runs FlytBase autonomous docks with Adentu across your 678 km² Atacama operation.' Then frame the Northern Operations lithium sites as the next step and offer to bring the Adentu/FlytBase team that ran the pilot. Before outreach, the AE should check with the FlytBase account owner whether SQM is an active customer, and should ask Rodrigo whether he already knows Rodrigo Toler (Deputy Manager of Digital Innovation), because an internal champion shortens the Q3 budget conversation. Lead with the 'days to hours' inspection time and the >95% reliability figures, since they answer the crew cost and hazard pains directly. Avoid quoting the yield figure until it is reconciled.

secondary.title: How Anglo American Uses Autonomous Drones to Transform Mining Safety in Peru
secondary.why: This is the referrer's own deployment. Anglo American runs FlytBase drone-in-a-box at the Quellaveco copper mine in Peru with LATAM implementation partner UAV LATAM. The case study says it replaced manual flights and truck travel and improved personnel safety in hazardous mountainous terrain. Use it to acknowledge the referral and to show a LATAM peer-miner deployment at scale. UAV LATAM is also a possible regional partner for Stage 5, alongside Adentu.

referral_connection.explanation: FlytBase's site has a case study on Anglo American, the referrer named in the email. Anglo American deployed FlytBase-powered drone-in-a-box at its Quellaveco copper mine in Peru through implementation partner UAV LATAM, replacing manual drone flights and truck transport between survey points for its topography team. Docks are placed on elevated positions to keep communication across mountainous terrain. The referral most likely comes from this LATAM mining deployment.

existing_relationship.explanation: Yes. FlytBase's case study shows SQM already partnered with Adentu (a Chile-based drone-autonomy integrator) and FlytBase. Together they took autonomous inspection from a pilot to a daily routine across SQM's 678 km² mining operation in the Atacama, northern Chile. The operation was irrigation leak, sprinkler and thermal inspection that affects iodine extraction, using DJI Dock drones scheduled by FlytBase, with data relayed to SQM's Azure environment for ML analysis. Reported results: inspection time cut from days to hours, >95% mission reliability, doubled inspection frequency, and improved iodine yield (the body says two percent, the headline says 4x). The case study is driven by SQM's digital innovation team (Rodrigo Toler), while the inbound lead comes from the Northern Operations Division for lithium sites, so this enquiry is likely a new division or use case within an existing account.
